metadata.question: Were blooms of phytoplankton visible in the Norwegian Sea during June 5, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-2 for visual observation of phytoplankton blooms (need true color or ocean color bands) - Date: June 5, 2019 (single day, may need to expand if no data) - Location: Norwegian Sea - approximate center around 67°N, 5°E 2. Masking strategy: - Need to avoid heavy cloud masking since we want to see if blooms are visible - Light cloud filtering to ensure we can actually see the ocean surface - Check for valid ocean pixels 3. Logic: - Phytoplankton blooms in ocean are visible through ocean color (greenish/turquoise hues) - Can use chlorophyll proxies or visual band ratios - Valid Zero (B): Clear ocean images but no bloom signature - C1: No images found - C2: All pixels masked/invalid - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - A: Bloom signatures detected For phytoplankton detection, I'll use Sentinel-2 and check for elevated green/blue ratios or use a simple chlorophyll indicator. I'll also validate with pixel counts. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const norwegianSea = ee.Geometry.Point([5.0, 67.0]).buffer(100000); // 100km radius const targetDate = '2019-06-05'; const dateRange = ee.Filter.date('2019-06-04', '2019-06-06'); // 2. Data Acquisition let collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(norwegianSea) .filter(dateRange) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)); const colSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sentinel-2 images found: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { // Try wider date range collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(norwegianSea) .filter(ee.Filter.date('2019-06-01', '2019-06-10')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)); const colSize2 = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Extended search images: ${colSize2}`); if (colSize2 === 0) { console.log("No images found in Norwegian Sea for early June 2019."); console.log("C1"); return; } } // 3. Processing - Select best image and create chlorophyll indicator const image = collection.sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').first(); // Light cloud mask const cloudMask = image.select('QA60').eq(0); const maskedImage = image.updateMask(cloudMask); // Check valid pixel count const pixelCount = maskedImage.select('B3').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: norwegianSea, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B3').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid ocean pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after cloud masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Phytoplankton bloom detection // Blooms show elevated green reflectance - use B3(Green)/B2(Blue) ratio const greenBand = maskedImage.select('B3'); const blueBand = maskedImage.select('B2'); const chlorophyllIndicator = greenBand.divide(blueBand); // Calculate statistics const stats = chlorophyllIndicator.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.max(), sharedInputs: true }).combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.percentile([90]), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: norwegianSea, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const meanRatio = stats['B3_mean']; const maxRatio = stats['B3_max']; const p90Ratio = stats['B3_p90']; console.log(`Green/Blue ratio - Mean: ${meanRatio ? meanRatio.toFixed(3) : 'null'}, Max: ${maxRatio ? maxRatio.toFixed(3) : 'null'}, P90: ${p90Ratio ? p90Ratio.toFixed(3) : 'null'}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (meanRatio === null || meanRatio === undefined || isNaN(meanRatio)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid results."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Phytoplankton blooms typically show Green/Blue > 1.2-1.3 // Check if significant bloom signatures exist (high P90 or elevated mean) if (p90Ratio > 1.25 || meanRatio > 1.15) { console.log("Phytoplankton bloom signatures detected."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("No significant bloom signatures detected."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
